title: laug · gate run
description: One gate, every cell it leased, live while it runs and the same weeks later: each reading against the max it was judged by, the A/A band an unchanged release sits in, the incumbent beside the release, the fault's marks, the harness's steps and the host. Each title says its source: record (the gate's own files, as follow copies them) or store (the cells' series, federated every 5 s while the gate ran). The two verdict words appear only where verdict.json is copied. Times are UTC. bin/obs find <gate id> prints this board's link with the gate's window.

list.name: Load items: the whole window, judged
list.expr: (last_over_time(laug_item_window_seconds{gate_id="$gate", window="whole", edge="start"}[$__range] @ end()) <= time() and on (item) last_over_time(laug_item_window_seconds{gate_id="$gate", window="whole", edge="end"}[$__range] @ end()) >= time()) * 1000

list.name: Fault: during and drain, recorded, not judged
list.expr: (last_over_time(laug_item_window_seconds{gate_id="$gate", window="during", edge="start"}[$__range] @ end()) <= time() and on (item) last_over_time(laug_item_window_seconds{gate_id="$gate", window="drain", edge="end"}[$__range] @ end()) >= time()) * 1000
list.titleFormat: {{item}}: during and drain, recorded, not judged

list.name: Fault: the after window, judged
list.expr: (last_over_time(laug_item_window_seconds{gate_id="$gate", window="after", edge="start"}[$__range] @ end()) <= time() and on (item) last_over_time(laug_item_window_seconds{gate_id="$gate", window="after", edge="end"}[$__range] @ end()) >= time()) * 1000

list.name: Fault: the recovery budget, from remove
list.expr: (last_over_time(laug_fault_mark_seconds{gate_id="$gate", mark="remove"}[$__range] @ end()) <= time() and on (item) (last_over_time(laug_fault_mark_seconds{gate_id="$gate", mark="remove"}[$__range] @ end()) + on (gate_id, item) last_over_time(laug_fault_signal{gate_id="$gate", field="budget"}[$__range] @ end())) >= time()) * 1000

panels.description: From timeline.jsonl's lines at their own times (laug_gate_step_seconds) and each item's exit.json. Each item: leasing from its lease line, leased from its leased line, running from the wave line, ended n from its ended line, n its exit.json's exit. panels.title: The Gate trace
panels.description: Links only: the trace store answers through its own UI and API, not through a Grafana panel.

options.content:
The orchestrator's worker and starter trace workflow `Gate` when started with `-otlp 127.0.0.1:7751` (Jaeger 2.21.0 keeps them).

- [Jaeger's own search: service laug-worker, temporalWorkflowID gate-$gate, this board's range](http://127.0.0.1:7761/search?service=laug-worker&tags=%7B%22temporalWorkflowID%22%3A%22gate-$gate%22%7D&start=${__from}000&end=${__to}000&lookback=custom): one RunActivity span an attempt, `temporalActivityID` the step.
- [The workflow in the orchestrator's dev server UI](http://127.0.0.1:8400/namespaces/default/workflows/gate-$gate), while `laug orchestrator server` runs.
- `bin/obs find $gate` counts the gate's traces and spans.

Each link needs its own port forward (7761, 8400), as 7740 does. Grafana 11.1.0's Jaeger datasource asks Jaeger's v1 API, which Jaeger 2.21.0 answers 404, so no panel here queries traces.

A span's end is when the worker stopped watching, not when the gate ended; attempts and outcomes are in the workflow history. RunWorkflow spans count replays, not runs, and a worker KILLed mid-step exports none of its open spans.
